description: This file is a Bash shell script designed to automate setup, cloning repositories, patching, building, testing, and coverage analysis for the entservices application gateway project. It manages dependencies, performs conditional rebuilds and reclones, applies patches, configures and builds multiple components, runs unit tests, and generates coverage reports.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs informational messages to standard output.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Outputs error messages to standard error.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if the current user has root privileges.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Checks if 'apt-get' can be run (i.e., if the script has root or sudo privileges).

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Executes commands and logs warnings on failure without aborting the script.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for non-interactive git commands.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Ensures a git repository is checked out to the specified ref.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if missing, and checks out a specified ref; supports recloning.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository in a non-interactive, idempotent manner.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks if a build directory has been configured (based on CMakeCache.txt).

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristically detects if components are installed, to skip rebuilds.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a component using CMake if needed.
